title: Perpetual Clementine
subtitle: A little peel. A little pause.
peelHint: Pull any part of the peel. A short tug settles back.
eatHint: Click to eat a segment, or hold and sweep across several. Release to eat.
keyboardHint: Arrows choose · Space peels / eats · R resets
keyboard: Arrow keys choose a starting point, then a piece. Space peels or eats it. R starts a fresh clementine. Escape cancels a gesture or closes the panel.
renewHint: Another little clementine is on its way.
startHint: Start at the top, side, or bottom. Your first pull shapes the peel.
